stories.title: Bari, morto il fotoreporter Luca Turi, raccontò lo sbarco della Vlora

en.title: Bari, photojournalist Luca Turi dies, he reported on the Vlora landing
en.summary: Luca Turi, a photojournalist who documented Puglia for over fifty years including the Vlora ship landing, has died in Bari. Regional president Decaro praised his ability to capture human details through his work.

stories.title: Il Metropolitan Opera apre le porte alla città: 70mila biglietti gratuiti per i newyorkesi

en.title: The Metropolitan Opera opens its doors to the city: 70,000 free tickets for New Yorkers
en.summary: The Metropolitan Opera is offering 70,000 free tickets to New York residents through a city initiative featuring renowned opera singers including soprano Rosa Feola, celebrating Italian lyrical singing as UNESCO world heritage.

stories.title: Papa Leone in Francia, alla messa in piazza a Parigi tutti (o quasi) gli aspiranti presidenti

en.title: Pope Francis in France, at the mass in Paris nearly all presidential hopefuls
en.summary: Pope Francis celebrated mass in Paris with numerous political figures in attendance. President Macron was absent in observance of church-state separation, while right and center political leaders competed to be present at the event.

stories.title: 15enne si arrampica sul traliccio elettrico e muore folgorato: ipotesi sfida social

en.title: 15-year-old climbs electrical pylon and dies electrocuted: social media challenge hypothesis
en.summary: A 15-year-old boy died after climbing an electrical pylon to approximately 20 meters despite warning signs. A selfie found on his smartphone taken at the top suggests he may have been attempting to create extreme content for social media.

stories.title: Polemiche per la foto 'modificata' di Siracusano rilanciata da Vannacci

en.title: Controversy over 'modified' photo of Siracusano shared by Vannacci
en.summary: Tajani called the action dishonorable. A general faces accusations against him without concrete basis, according to the outlet's reporting.

stories.title: Vannacci rilancia foto scollata di Matilde Siracusano ritoccata con l'IA, FI insorge

en.title: Vannacci shares lowcut photo of Matilde Siracusano retouched with AI, Forza Italia protests
en.summary: The undersecretary is considering legal action and protests are expanding. The founder of Futuro Nazionale states the photo is not his.

stories.title: Morto a 15 anni folgorato su un traliccio, ipotesi sfida social

en.title: 15-year-old killed by electrocution on a pylon, social media challenge suspected
en.summary: In the Lodi province, a teenager climbed to a height of 20 meters, apparently to take a selfie.

stories.title: Russell vince a Baku davanti a Verstappen. Antonelli da 16° a 5°, Ferrari giù dal podio

en.title: Russell wins in Baku ahead of Verstappen. Antonelli from 16th to 5th, Ferrari off the podium
en.summary: Russell led the entire Azerbaijan Grand Prix from start to finish in his Mercedes. His teammate Verstappen recovered to second place while maintaining his championship lead, and Ferrari failed to secure a podium finish.

stories.title: GP Azerbaijan: Russell domina a Baku, Verstappen secondo, Antonelli chiude quinto

en.title: Azerbaijan GP: Russell dominates in Baku, Verstappen second, Antonelli finishes fifth
en.summary: Russell dominated the Azerbaijan Grand Prix while Verstappen secured second place and maintained his world championship lead despite losing ground. Ferrari missed the podium for the fifth consecutive race.

stories.title: La forzista Siracusano: la mia foto ritoccata da Vannacci? Io spogliata per propaganda, lo denuncio

en.title: Forza Italia's Siracusano: my photo retouched by Vannacci? Me undressed for propaganda, I will report it
en.summary: A shirt was replaced with a deep neckline in the altered image. The undersecretary for Parliamentary Relations and Forza Italia deputy called the act disgusting.

stories.title: Lodi, 15enne morto folgorato su un traliccio nel lodigiano, ipotesi incidente per sfida social

en.title: Lodi, 15-year-old killed by electrocution on pylon in Lodi area, suspected accident from social media challenge
en.summary: A 15-year-old boy named Jacopo Rossi Trabattoni was found dead on an electrical pylon Friday evening by power company technicians. The death is suspected to have resulted from a social media challenge accident.

stories.title: Gp Azerbaigian: trionfo Russell in volata su Verstappen, Antonelli rimonta ed è 5°

en.title: Azerbaijan GP: Russell's triumph in a close race over Verstappen, Antonelli climbs to 5th
en.summary: Russell won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix in a closely fought contest with Verstappen, with safety car periods creating dramatic moments. Ferrari missed the podium for the fourth consecutive race while the championship leader extended his advantage.

stories.title: Caputi: «Trasformare l’attrattività dell’Italia in ricchezza diffusa»

en.title: Caputi: "Transform Italy's attractiveness into widespread wealth"
en.summary: An end-of-term agreement with the government includes a simplification decree to convert Italy's appeal into broader economic benefits.

stories.title: Fondi UE, il rischio di fare bene le cose sbagliate: la riforma che cambia le regole di valutazione dal 2028

en.title: EU Funds, the risk of doing well the wrong things: the reform that changes evaluation rules from 2028
en.summary: European Union fund evaluation methods are being reformed, changing how results are measured, counted, and verified starting in 2028. The reform is among several policy matters under discussion in Brussels for the upcoming budget cycle.
